news.title: Lindsey Graham, Republican Senator and Trump Ally, Dies From ‘Sudden Illness’
news.summary: He died from “a brief and sudden illness,” his office said. Over more than two decades in the Senate, he consistently pushed for the use of U.S. military power overseas.
